g.text: Measured 30-second excerpts · separate stereo channels · no clinical inference

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607168

g.text: Methods: spectra average 131,072-sample Hann windows (50% overlap); 150 sampled short windows form each spectrogram.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607168

g.text: Spectra and spectrograms each use an independent 0 dB reference per recording. Colors do not compare absolute loudness across recordings.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607168

g.text: dBFS is a digital level, not ear-level dB SPL. These plots describe sound—not brainwaves, migraine relief, or a personal “sweet spot.”
